profiles.label: FEVM contract
profiles.description: Solidity contracts that use Filecoin actor APIs, precompiles, or FEVM-specific libraries.
profiles.confidence_basis: Filecoin Solidity imports, API symbols, or reserved precompile addresses are present in contract source.

profiles.label: FVM actor
profiles.description: Rust crates that implement or depend on Filecoin Virtual Machine actor interfaces.
profiles.confidence_basis: The Cargo manifest declares an FVM SDK, shared runtime, or actor runtime dependency.

profiles.label: Go node
profiles.description: Lotus-, Venus-, or Filecoin-state-aware Go node software.
profiles.confidence_basis: The Go module declares a Lotus, Venus, or Filecoin state-types dependency.

profiles.label: Infrastructure
profiles.description: Terraform, Kubernetes, or container configuration that defines deployable infrastructure.
profiles.confidence_basis: A recognized infrastructure file contains Terraform, Kubernetes workload, or container-build configuration.

profiles.label: Service application
profiles.description: Network-facing service applications and APIs in the Filecoin ecosystem.
profiles.confidence_basis: A package manifest declares a recognized network service framework or runtime entry point.

profiles.label: Storage application
profiles.description: Applications integrating Filecoin or IPFS storage service libraries.
profiles.confidence_basis: A package manifest declares a recognized Filecoin or IPFS storage client dependency.

profiles.label: Storage-provider infrastructure
profiles.description: Infrastructure that deploys or authorizes Lotus Miner, Boost, Curio, Venus Sealer, or related storage-provider software.
profiles.confidence_basis: Infrastructure configuration names storage-provider software, privileged API variables, or proof-parameter storage.
